name: obw
description: Obsidian Workspace — project-scoped vault productivity (capture / notes / PM). Skills own folder layout and templates; /obw:pm splits a spec into blocking tickets; /issue is a Claude Mod pane that lists a view of the project's dashboard, draws Mermaid as text diagrams, and can open a card in the browser through viz. Vault I/O uses the Obsidian CLI via the official obsidian-cli skill.
